senses.definition: In multiworld randomizers, when progress is blocked in one game by exhausting all checks available, awaiting progress to be done in a different game.
In multiworld randomizers, to block progress in one game by exhausting all checks available, then awaiting progress to be done in a different game.
A virus very similar to JC virus, ubiquitous and rarely causing disease in healthy people but creating urogenital problems in the immunosuppressed.
In multiworld randomizers, in a state of having progress blocked in one game by exhausting all checks available, awaiting progress to be done in a different game.
